reason: Review mutations use only the exact displayed snapshot, preserve unrelated index and working content, and refuse incomplete or inapplicable selections.

hunkPolicy.text: apply one host-rebuilt hunk with its original ranges and newline notes
hunkPolicy.rename: tracked relation metadata applies with the selected hunk; inferred moves require the whole file
hunkPolicy.embeddedRepository: whole parent-index pointer only; preserve the nested checkout and refuse hunk actions

stagedRevertPolicy: The working file must match the displayed index. Undisplayed working edits cause a conflict.

gitlinks.stageAndUnstage: Apply captured canonical mode160000 pointers only to the parent index; preserve nested HEAD and dirty/untracked bytes.
gitlinks.untracked: Export and stage the recorded nested HEAD pointer without recursive file reads.
gitlinks.revert: Explicitly unavailable; never report success without restoring the nested checkout.
gitlinks.races: Reject stale capture/index pointers and preserve late nested working revisions.
